negative_snippets:
DON'T BOOK THIS HOTEL AT ANY COST!

I booked this hotel in October 2025 late night because it was near where I was.
1. It's located in a residential area - has no parking and has a public ground next to it. Online they listed the property having parking on premise.
2. The ground had an event going on with a huge gathering and a lot of noise going on. I believe it was a religious gathering of sorts.
3. Hotel listed the rooms incorrectly on online platforms. There was a room listed as 440sq ft. In reality it wasn't even 140sq ft.. The hotel staff agreed to refund and cancel the booking the next morning after my disagreement. The next day they denied to refund the booking amount. I had just made the booking 10 minutes ago and paid online - my mistake to have paid them online before reaching there.

Lesson learnt to stay away from these shady lala hotels in Karol Bagh ran by scammers.

I HAD CALL THE POLICE TO HELP ME
HOTEL INFECTED WITH BED BUGS
THE OWNER AND STAFF ARE ABSOLUTELY PATHETIC

I had one of the worst hotel experiences here. I stayed one night and changed rooms the next morning, only to discover bed bugs again in the new room at night. The rooms were unhygienic and poorly maintained. When I informed the hotel staff, instead of apologizing or helping, they argued with me and refused to provide a refund, even though I had clear proof of the infestation. Don't bother wasting your money with this hotel, the owner of the hotel Rajesh or Rakesh, whatever his name is, is absolutely rude and swearing at me for complaining.

It was 11 PM, and the staff wasted my time, showing no concern for the guest’s safety or comfort. This is completely unacceptable and unprofessional behavior. I had to consider calling the police because of the harassment and lack of cooperation.

Avoid this hotel at all costs — they do not care about cleanliness, guest comfort, or basic hospitality standards. Totally unworthy of the price they charge.
